title: Marvell在人工智能芯片交易中向谷歌授予价值122亿美元的股票认购权
content:
Marvell Technology issued Google a warrant to purchase up to 58.97 million shares of its common stock, valued at as much as $12.2 billion if fully exercised, as part of a new custom semiconductor agreement, the company said. Marvell stock jumped more than 11% in premarket trading on Wednesday.
The warrant, issued on Tuesday, carries an exercise price of $206.58 per share and is exercisable until August 18, 2033, according to the filing. A stake of that size would make Google Marvell's fifth-largest investor, according to Reuters.
The underlying commercial agreement, signed on July 29, covers a range of chips built to work with Google's tensor processing unit ecosystem, including AI inference accelerators, storage controllers, network interface controllers, memory interface controllers, and near-memory compute, the company said.
Rather than accruing on a fixed schedule, the bulk of the warrant shares unlock only as Google hits cumulative spending thresholds. Of the total 58.97 million shares, about 1.36 million vest in equal quarterly installments during the first year of the agreement, the company said. The remaining shares vest in 240 equal tranches — one tranche for each $500 million in custom products revenue Marvell records from Google purchases — running from Marvell's third quarter of fiscal 2027 through the end of fiscal 2033.
In practice, the arrangement means Google's ownership position in Marvell will scale in direct proportion to its cumulative procurement spending under the deal. The warrant may not be transferred to parties outside Google's controlled affiliates without Marvell's consent, and the shares, if vested, will be subject to securities laws and specified trading volume restrictions, the company said.
Marvell enters the deal with Broadcom already entrenched as Google's primary custom chip partner under a separate agreement covering future chip generations and related components that runs through 2031, according to Reuters. Shares of Broadcom fell more than 2% in premarket trading Wednesday.
Companies increasingly turning away from Nvidia's graphics processors have driven up appetite for custom silicon tailored to Google's TPU infrastructure, particularly for AI inference workloads.

report.summary: Marvell向谷歌授予122亿美元认股权证，绑定定制芯片交易。
report.background: 随着AI计算需求激增，越来越多公司寻求英伟达GPU的替代方案，定制芯片需求旺盛。博通已是谷歌TPU生态的主要定制芯片伙伴，合作至2031年。Marvell为打入该供应链，与谷歌签署长期定制芯片协议，并授予谷歌巨额认股权证，使其成为潜在第五大股东。谷歌的持股比例将与其采购金额直接挂钩，形成“采购换股权”的深度绑定模式。
key_points: Marvell向谷歌发行5897万股认股权证，行权价206.58美元，最高价值122亿美元，谷歌或成其第五大股东。
该权证基于7月29日签署的定制芯片协议，覆盖AI推理加速器、存储控制器、网络接口等谷歌TPU生态芯片。
大部分权证按谷歌累计采购金额分240批解锁，每50亿美元采购解锁一批，从2027财年Q3持续到2033财年末。
权证不可转让给谷歌关联方以外实体，且受证券法和交易量限制，体现双方长期战略绑定意图。
消息公布后Marvell盘前涨11%，博通跌2%，反映市场对谷歌定制芯片供应链格局变化的预期。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，Marvell与谷歌的绑定加速了定制芯片生态的发展，进一步削弱英伟达在AI推理市场的主导地位。对开发者来说，更多定制芯片选项意味着更差异化的算力解决方案，但软硬件兼容性仍需关注。对普通用户而言，长期可能带来AI服务成本下降和应用创新，但短期市场格局变化有限。
report.tools: 关注Marvell（MRVL）、博通（AVGO）和谷歌TPU相关动态；开源工具如Google的TensorFlow、JAX可用于TPU开发，XLA编译器可优化推理负载；芯片分析可参考Semianalysis和The Next Platform的定制芯片报告。
